In this phase, students will: Understand networking fundamentals , including LAN, WAN, IP addressing (IPv4/IPv6), routing, switching, and basic configurations. Get hands-on training on real networking devices and tools to simulate practical environments. Learn Linux commands, file systems, user and permission management , and server basics, as Linux plays a key role in ethical hacking and cybersecurity tools. Set up and manage network configurations and troubleshoot connectivity using industry best practices. By the end of this stage, learners will have the essential technical groundwork required to move forward in advanced cybersecurity modules such as ethical hacking and VAPT training. Stage 2: (CEH V13 + Global Certification) (2 months) CEH V13 is the most recent version launched by EC-Council in the domain of Cybersecurity. As a core-level certification, CEH is essential for professionals seeking a strong foundation in ethical hacking. This course equips learners with a deep understanding of hacking techniques and tools, while teaching how to use them legally and responsibly. The training emphasizes both theoretical knowledge and hands-on practice with industry-relevant tools. Why Choose CEH at 3RI Technologies? Get instruction from instructors who have practical cybersecurity experience. Small, focused batches of only 5–7 students for personalized learning Hands-on, practical training aligned with real-world scenarios Emphasis on live, interactive sessions with full doubt resolution Separate batches for individual learners and corporate professionals Exclusive study materials tailored for exam success Stage 3: VAPT Training (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing) (3 months) The CEH certification helps learners adopt a hacker’s mindset, which is essential for stepping confidently into Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT). This fundamental course establishes the framework for comprehending how systems are compromised and how to responsibly stop those breaches. In order to identify and address security flaws before they may be exploited, VAPT is a crucial industry compliance requirement. It provides thorough analysis and reports that support the development of an organization’s cybersecurity infrastructure. Focus Areas for VAPT Training: Mobile Application Penetration Testing Network Penetration Testing Penetration testing of web applications The VAPT course at 3RI Technologies is a rigorous, 3-month program with over 100 hours of hands-on, practical training. Learners are trained in advanced VAPT techniques and methodologies, enabling them to conduct full-scale security audits, generate professional VAPT reports, and provide strategic analysis of IT infrastructures aligned with global standards and frameworks. Hands-on setup of WLAN using WEP, WPA, and WPA2 in a controlled environment. Discuss the vulnerabilities of each protocol and the improvements made from WEP through WPA-3. Can I get employment after completing this course? Yes, after completing the cybersecurity course at 3RI Technologies , you’ll be job-ready with in-demand skills aligned to industry needs and trends . 2. Another essential component of a successful cybersecurity profession is industry trends. Absolutely! Our training is updated as per latest cybersecurity trends , ensuring you’re aligned with current industry standards for better job prospects. 3. Is there a course that is only focused on jobs? Yes, the cybersecurity combo course at 3RI Technologies is job-oriented , focusing on hands-on skills, real-time scenarios, and placement support . 4. What credentials are needed to enroll in this course? Anyone with basic computer knowledge or a background in IT can enroll in the cybersecurity course at 3RI Technologies . 5. Is coding or programming knowledge required for the cybersecurity course? No prior programming is mandatory; however, a basic understanding can be helpful. 3RI Technologies teaches you everything from scratch. 6. What salary package can I get after this course? Our students receive packages ranging from ₹ 3.0 L to ₹ 6.0 L per annum , depending on skills, performance, and company requirements . 7. Which is the best certificate in cybersecurity for beginners? The CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) course at 3RI Technologies is highly recommended for beginners entering the cybersecurity domain . 8. How long does the course last? The comprehensive cybersecurity program at 3RI Technologies runs for 6 months , covering over 100+ hours of practical learning . 9. What are the roles of an ethical hacker in a company? An ethical hacker finds, tests, and addresses vulnerabilities to defend the company’s IT infrastructure from online attacks. 10. What are the job opportunities in cybersecurity? After the course, you can apply for roles like Security Analyst, Penetration Tester, Cyber Threat Analyst, and Information Security Engineer .
